title: json: even further optimize JSON output (10.2x total speedup)
description:
Continue work from !25374 and !25383

- Add fast path for unique sibling keys (avoid GSList allocation)
- Pre-check whether all sibling keys are unique (common case) using a reusable hash table stored in write_json_data
- When no duplicates found, write children directly via write_json_proto_node_single(), skipping GSList alloc/free entirely
- Switch proto_node_group_children_by_json_key to g_direct_hash/equal (json keys are interned pointers, string comparison unnecessary)
- Add json_dumper_set_member_name_noesc for keys known to need no escaping (hfinfo-\>abbrev and literal strings), halving json_puts_string overhead

Measured with `-T json -x --no-duplicate-keys` on 1000-packet NGAP capture:

* Before: 31.0s
* After: 3.0s (10.2x faster, up from 6.6x in previous commit)

Output is byte-for-byte identical.

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)
